summary: Frontend-only validation executed on preview URL with isolated localStorage fixtures. Header/nav redesign and most dashboard interactions passed. Found critical regression in month fixture discoverability (2028-02 not surfaced) and could not complete log-form save regression due unstable category/subcategory option mapping against injected fixture.

ui_bugs.issue: Form inputs lack data-testid coverage; automated and reliable assertion for category/subcategory/account mapping is brittle.

integration_issues.issue: After injecting fixture transaction dated 2028-02-29, net-worth month select did not expose 2028-02 option, preventing leap-year end-date validation in UI flow.

3 attempts failed to stably select expected subcategory option from scripted fixture; selector reached correct field but expected option values were not present at runtime, blocking completion of save-then-verify assertion.

action_items: Investigate why injected 2028-02 transaction month is not consistently reflected in availableMonths UI option list.
Add unique data-testid attributes to TransactionEntryView interactive fields (amount, description, category, subcategory, account/card select, submit) for stable regression automation.
Main agent should manually verify log transaction save + dashboard reflection once selector/testability issue is addressed.
critical_code_review_comments: FinanceContext.tsx exceeds 700 lines and mixes persistence, auth simulation, calculations, and UI-facing helpers; split into focused hooks/modules for maintainability and safer regression coverage.
types.ts declares GoogleAccountInfo interface twice with divergent shape; declaration merging can introduce unintended optional field behavior and confusion.
PRE-EXISTING frontend Google sign-in / backup / OTP auth flows are MOCKED and remain disconnected from backend APIs by design.
seed_data_creation: Browser-only isolated localStorage fixtures created for user records_ui_review. No backend/database seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed 3 Playwright runs. Passed: header rename/removals, profile settings open, non-dash month toolbar placement, responsive no-overflow checks at 320/375/768/1024/1440, Sep 1-30 + 7D Sep 1-7 + Oct 31 chart labels, tooltip click/keyboard/close/reset, scrolled new-entry navigation. Blockers: 2028-02 option did not appear in net-worth month select despite fixture tx date 2028-02-29; log-form add-transaction flow hit repeated subcategory option mismatch (stopped after 3 attempts per loop-prevention rule).
rca of the issue: Likely state/fixture consistency gap between injected localStorage payload and in-app category/month derivation at runtime. Repro: inject records_ui_review payload with tx on 2028-02-29 and category IDs, reload, then inspect [data-testid='net-worth-month-select'] (2028-02 absent) and log form subcategory options (values differ from injected IDs). Mitigation: add deterministic fixture import utility + data-testid fields for form controls + expose current loaded user/data snapshot for test diagnostics.
